Earlier reports indicated that Real Madrid plans to hold talks with the player's representatives this week regarding his future, with discussions likely to focus on the possibility of a new long-term contract. London's Arsenal is looking to strengthen its left flank this summer and is showing interest in Vinícius, closely monitoring the situation. Gunners head coach Mikel Arteta is keen on acquiring the Brazilian, while Real Madrid is also interested in securing an extension of the player's contract. Vinícius's current contract runs only until the end of next season, and if a new agreement cannot be reached, the Madrid club may consider selling the player this summer to avoid losing him for free a year later.

items.title: Wrexham face Liverpool with Premier League still in their sights despite setback | Wrexham | The Guardian
items.summary:
Parkinson’s team face Liverpool with confidence in the Bronx on Wednesday having defeated Manchester United and Leeds in pre-season so far and moved on from the anguish of missing out on the Championship playoffs on the final day of last season. The near-miss was undoubtedly a setback to an ambitious club’s grand vision but finishing seventh in the Championship at the first time of asking, Parkinson insists, was an accomplishment that should not be dismissed lightly. [...] The Wrexham co-owner Ryan Reynolds called it a “punch-me moment” – his club playing Liverpool in a pre-season friendly at Yankee Stadium just five years after he and Rob McElhenney (now simply Rob Mac) completed their takeover of a club languishing in the National League. The knockout blow would be playing Liverpool at Anfield in the Premier League in 2027-28 and the manager, Phil Parkinson, accepts there is expectation on Wrexham to complete their remarkable rise through the divisions next [...] “It is going to be a tough second season, we know that, but we feel there is more to come from the existing group. It was difficult last season with a lot of players coming in later and having to relocate to the area and settle as the season started, but they were great for us and I feel there is more to come this season.”
